_meta.method: CDP getComputedStyle on live pages (desktop 1440x900, mobile 390x844), CSS rules via document.styleSheets, network log, page HTML. Values in px unless noted.
_meta.unmeasured: values marked 'by eye' are read from screenshots only

stack.frontend: jQuery 3.7.1 + jQuery UI (draggable/resizable/dialog/checkboxradio) + Drupal behaviors; search results page is an Angular app (custom element <app-beta>, 'angular' hint in bundle); scan viewer is a custom Vite/React-style app module na_openseadragon (index-C9ZDM9RF.js + index-Crk-QKv4.css, v=1.49)
stack.viewer: OpenSeadragon (canvas .openseadragon-container) over IIIF Image API served by IIPsrv at service.archief.nl (info.json + 256x256 tiles, jp2)
stack.i18n: gtranslate Drupal module (modules/contrib/gtranslate) = machine translation dropdown, not hand-made translations
stack.chat: LibraryH3lp (eu.libraryh3lp.com) 'U kunt nu chatten' + side tab 'Feedback'
stack.github: not searched/none verified for the theme or viewer
stack.design_system: own theme natarch (colour = Rijkshuisstijl blue #01689b); no public design system

sans.family: "Source Sans 3" (regular), "Source Sans 3 Bold" as separate @font-face (700), italics; fallback "Arial regular"/"Arial bold", sans-serif

fonts.icons: Font Awesome 5 Free, 6 Brands, 7 Free (woff2 in themes/custom/natarch/css/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts)

type_scale_px.h1_home_hero: 104/104 bold white (on image, with text shadow by eye)

colour.link_primary_blue: #01689b (rgb 1,104,155) - links, nav bar, search button, active tab text
colour.accent_orange: #f06e23 (home search submit, rgb 240,110,35); card top border rgb(225,112,0)
colour.viewer_bg: dark blue-grey ~#263238 (by eye), viewer chrome black #000 / rgba(0,0,0,.8), top bar #01689b

layout.grid: no CSS grid variables; flex/float columns; home 3 equal cards (427px each, gap 32px); news/agenda 2x2 cards 312px wide

header.desktop: utility row (Winkelwagen, Inloggen, Over het NA, Contact, language dropdown with globe 'Nederlands', Zoeken) at y~113 on white + logo top right ~182px wide; below it the main nav bar 46px high (Home, Onderzoeken, Beleven, Archiveren): bg #01689b, white bold 16px text, active tab = #cce0f1 bg with dark text; then breadcrumb band 53px (#cce0f1) with underlined bold links and chevron separators; total header+crumbs ~237px
header.mobile: blue bar ~69px with white logo (~80px) + 'Menu' bold + hamburger; breadcrumb band ~32px

shape.radius: 0 almost everywhere (buttons, inputs, cards); only 50% for round viewer buttons and 0 0 10px 10px for side 'Feedback' tab
shape.input: 48px high, bg #efefea (home) / rgba(0,0,0,.1) (search), padding 5 195 5 20, no border, inner shadow; on results page white with 1px dark border by eye
shape.dividers: 2px light grey rule between search results (by eye), hr in cards

search_results.tabs: 8 type tabs with counts: Archieven (83) | Fotocollectie (2) | Kaarten (0) | Indexen (2) | Zoekhulpen (2) | Onderzoeken (1) | Nieuws (0) | Agenda (0); inactive = #01689b bg white text 48px high 87+px wide with 1px white separators; active = white bg, bold dark text, top border; mobile = one dropdown 'Archieven (83)'
search_results.facets: left column 312px: 'Periode' (two number inputs 1000 / 2026 + dual-handle blue slider), 'Bevat digitaal materiaal' (checkbox), 'Openbaarheid', 'Actor' (list with counts); each facet header bar #efefea with bold 16px title + chevron; mobile = 'Filters' and 'Weergave' buttons 2-up, 48px
search_results.sort: selects 'Sorteer op' (Relevantie) + 'Aantal per pagina' (10), 48px high, 1px dark border, chevron icon
search_results.result: title link '2.14.03 Inventaris van het archief van ...' bold 18/28 #01689b; 'Periode: 1766-1988' (label bold); optional snippet with pink highlight; expander 'Snel overzicht zoekresultaten (11)' with chevron (inline list of matching units); separator rule between results

inventory_page.title: h1 32/42 bold 'code Inventaris van het archief van ... (years)'
inventory_page.downloads: 'Download inventaris als: PDF | XML' (+ /download/pdf, /download/xml) and 'Taalgebruik in onze archieven' link
inventory_page.right_rail: 'Zoekhulpen bij dit archief': stacked grey (#deded9) link buttons with bold blue text + chevron, each 46-70px
inventory_page.in_inventory_search: row: 'Filters tonen' (disabled grey) | input 'Voer een zoekterm in' | select 'Zoek in archiefbestanddelen' | blue 'Zoeken' button | hit counter '0 / 0' | prev/next chevron buttons
inventory_page.tree_panel: left accordion: 'Archiefbeschrijving' (grey bar) and 'Archiefbestanddelen' (blue bar #01689b open, white bold) with nested collapsible tree: Deel I > Deel I/A OCTROOIEN ... with [-] / [+] icons
inventory_page.content: right column: nested headings with L-shaped connectors ('Deel I' > 'Deel I/A OCTROOIEN' > '1 Octrooi verleend door ...'), inventory-number links in bold blue

scan_viewer.layout: full-viewport overlay: top bar 48px #01689b (download icon left, 'Sluiten x' right) -> black bar 56px with tabs 'Informatie' | 'Transcriptie' and right search 'Zoek in archief/transcriptie' (white input ~320px, search icon, up/down hit arrows 48px) -> dark canvas with floating black toolbar centered at top (rotate right, rotate left, contrast/brightness, zoom out, zoom % dropdown, zoom in) -> side arrows 64x64 (next = black, prev dimmed when first) -> bottom black pill 'Scan [ 1 ] van 11' with page input
scan_viewer.data: scans[] JSON embedded in HTML: {id (uuid), label NL-HaNA_1.04.02_1_01.jpg, order, default{url,size ~1.4-2.8MB,jpeg}, thumbnail{url}, iiif{url info.json}}; availability 'DIGITALIZED'; has_scan_navigation flag

components.language_switcher: globe icon + 'Nederlands' + chevron dropdown in utility row; 10 entries: Nederlands, English, Français, Deutsch, Português, Español, Bahasa Indonesia, Íslenska, Kreyol ayisyen, Frysk (gtranslate module)
components.home_cards: 3 cards 427px wide, ~179px high incl. top bar: 14px(by eye) colour top bar (blue #01689b / orange #e17000 / green #39870c), title 'Onderzoeken' bold 22px(by eye) + chevron, divider rule, 16px description; shadow 0 0 3px .09
components.news_agenda_cards: white card 312px wide, image on top, date badge top-left (dark #4b4646-ish bg, white 15px 'Vanaf 16 november 2026'), bold title 18/22; section headings 'Nieuws >' / 'Agenda >' in bold serif
components.footer: height 554px, link titles 18/24 bold (Onderzoeken, Beleven, Archiveren columns), 'Scroll to top', phone 070 - 3315400, 'Neem contact op', legal links (Toegankelijkheidsverklaring, Kwetsbaarheid melden, Taalgebruik, Privacy, Algemene voorwaarden)
components.feedback_tab: fixed vertical 'Feedback' tab on right edge with chat icon, bottom corners radius 10px
